import html from string import Template # Predefined HTML template with placeholders. INVITATION_FORMAT = """ $title_of_event Invitation
$title_of_event
$event_details
Date: $scheduled_date
$extra_info
""" def create_event_invitation(title_of_event: str, event_details: str, scheduled_date: str, extra_info: str) -> str: """ Generates a sanitized HTML invitation. Parameters ---------- title_of_event : str The name or title of the event. event_details : str A comprehensive description (may contain newlines). scheduled_date : str The date of the event. extra_info : str Additional instructions or notes. Returns ------- str A string containing the sanitized HTML invitation. """ # Escape all user-provided input to neutralize special characters. safe_title = html.escape(title_of_event, quote=True) safe_details = html.escape(event_details, quote=True).replace('\n', '
') safe_date = html.escape(scheduled_date, quote=True) safe_extra = html.escape(extra_info, quote=True).replace('\n', '
') template = Template(INVITATION_FORMAT) return template.substitute( title_of_event=safe_title, event_details=safe_details, scheduled_date=safe_date, extra_info=safe_extra )
